karty.priklad: Mae'r gath yn cysgu yn y gadair freichiau.
karty.priklad_cs: The cat is sleeping in the armchair (cadair → [g]adair after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: cadair (chair) + breichiau (arms): a chair with arms, upholstered in ruby-red velvet.

extra.pozn: breichiau is the plural of braich, mutated after the feminine cadair (b → f); own example

karty.priklad: Canodd y gloch am hanner dydd.
karty.priklad_cs: The bell rang at midday (cloch → [g]loch after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: CLOCH sounds like CLOCK: the clock-tower bell glows red-hot from ringing all day.

extra.pozn: clychau'n canu is from the coursebook (p. 105), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Rho'r glustog ar y gadair freichiau.
karty.priklad_cs: Put the cushion on the armchair (clustog → [g]lustog after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: clust = ear: a cushion to put under your ear, embroidered with ladybirds.

extra.pozn: own example; a pillow for the bed = gobennydd (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Mae diffyg cwsg yn cael effaith fawr ar fy ngwaith i.
karty.priklad_cs: Lack of sleep has a big effect on my work (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine effaith; gwaith → [ng]waith after fy).
karty.mnemo: Like English EFFECT: the effect of a sauna – you come out lobster-red.

extra.pozn: effeithio (ar) = to affect (L19); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd enfys fawr dros y môr ar ôl y glaw.
karty.priklad_cs: There was a big rainbow over the sea after the rain (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine enfys).
karty.mnemo: The rainbow makes the sky ENVIOUS (EN-FYS) – its red stripe blazes brightest of all.

extra.pozn: gweld enfys is from the coursebook (p. 105), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Ddylai fe ddim bod wedi prynu'r ffa.
karty.priklad_cs: He shouldn't have bought the beans (Jack and the Beanstalk).
karty.mnemo: ffa = beans (collective), -en = one single bean: a red kidney bean bubbling in tomato soup.

extra.pozn: the plural ffa is a collective noun; sentence from the exercise Jac a'r goeden ffa (p. 107)

sever.priklad: Ddylai fo ddim bod wedi prynu'r ffa.
sever.priklad_cs: He shouldn't have bought the beans (Jack and the Beanstalk).

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n canu'r ffidil yn y gerddorfa.
karty.priklad_cs: She plays the violin in the orchestra (cerddorfa → [g]erddorfa after y; ff does not mutate).
karty.mnemo: From English FIDDLE: the devil plays a red fiddle over glowing embers.

extra.pozn: canu offeryn = to play an instrument; own example

karty.priklad: Beth sy'n rhoi gwên ar eich wyneb chi?
karty.priklad_cs: What puts a smile on your face?
karty.mnemo: gwên ~ gwen (white): gleaming white teeth between bright red lipstick.

extra.pozn: gwenu = to smile (p. 105: gwneud i chi wenu, gwenu → [w]enu after i); sentence from p. 105

sever.priklad: Be sy'n rhoi gwên ar eich wyneb chi?
sever.priklad_cs: What puts a smile on your face?

karty.priklad: Roedd heulwen braf drwy'r dydd.
karty.priklad_cs: There was lovely sunshine all day.
karty.mnemo: haul (sun) + -wen (white): blazing white sunshine that leaves you with sunburn.

extra.pozn: no plural; Heulwen is also a girl's name; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r plant wrth eu bodd gyda storïau tylwyth teg.
karty.priklad_cs: The children love fairy stories (literally: stories about fairies).
karty.mnemo: tylwyth (family, clan) + teg (fair, beautiful): the fair folk; a fairy in a poppy-red dress dances in a field of poppies.

extra.pozn: teg → deg after the feminine tylwythen; Storïau Tylwyth Teg is a heading on p. 106, the sentence is my own

sever.priklad: Mae'r plant wrth eu bodd efo storïau tylwyth teg.
sever.priklad_cs: The children love fairy stories (literally: stories about fairies).

karty.priklad: Dylwn i fod wedi tynnu'r addurniadau Nadolig i lawr.
karty.priklad_cs: I should have taken the Christmas decorations down.
karty.mnemo: Like English ADORN: sapphire-blue baubles adorning the Christmas tree.

extra.pozn: addurno = to decorate (L13); addurniadau Nadolig is from the coursebook (p. 105), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Mae alergedd gyda fi i gnau.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm allergic to nuts (cnau → [g]nau after i).
karty.mnemo: From English allergy: you sneeze so hard your blue ice lolly flies off the stick.

extra.pozn: own example; alergaidd (allergic) outside the coursebook

sever.priklad: Mae gen i alergedd i gnau.
sever.priklad_cs: I'm allergic to nuts (cnau → [g]nau after i).
sever.pozn: north: Mae gen i instead of Mae … gyda fi (L6)

karty.priklad: Cymerwch gam yn ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: Take a step back (cam → [g]am after the command).
karty.mnemo: Take one step back, CAMera (CAM) ready, to fit the whole penguin colony in the shot.

extra.pozn: cam wrth gam = step by step; cam is also an adjective: crooked, wrong (hence camgymeriad); own example

karty.priklad: Gwnes i gamgymeriad mawr.
karty.priklad_cs: I made a big mistake (camgymeriad → [g]amgymeriad after gwnes i).
karty.mnemo: cam (wrong) + cymryd (to take) = a MIS-TAKE, just like English: grabbing frozen fish fingers instead of the chocolate.

extra.pozn: camgymryd = to be mistaken; own example

karty.cs_upresneni: on a door, not a canal lock
karty.priklad: Roedd y drws ar glo, felly torrodd y lleidr y clo.
karty.priklad_cs: The door was locked, so the thief broke the lock (clo → [g]lo after ar).
karty.mnemo: CLO ~ English CLOSE: a steel lock snaps the freezer door closed.

extra.pozn: ar glo = locked (L9); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n dioddef o ddiffyg cwsg.
karty.priklad_cs: I suffer from lack of sleep (diffyg → [dd]iffyg after o).
karty.mnemo: cysgu = to sleep → cwsg = sleep, deep as a walrus snoring on the ice.

extra.pozn: no plural; sentence from Robin Radio (p. 116)

karty.priklad: Gadawa i fy nghot i yn y cyntedd.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll leave my coat in the hall (cot → [ngh]ot after fy).
karty.mnemo: cynta = first: the hall is the first room inside the door, where the snow globe sits on the shelf.

extra.pozn: the link with cynta is only a memory aid; own example

karty.priklad: Dylwn i fod wedi codi'r chwyn.
karty.priklad_cs: I should have pulled up the weeds.
karty.mnemo: chwyn = weeds (collective), -yn = one single weed; it survives even the hardest frost.

extra.pozn: the plural chwyn is a collective noun; sentence from p. 105

karty.priklad: Mae diffyg amser dros y penwythnos yn broblem hefyd.
karty.priklad_cs: Lack of time at the weekend is a problem too (problem → [b]roblem after yn).
karty.mnemo: diffyg ~ DEFICIT / DEFECT: the blue ice-cream van has a defect – and a deficit of cornets.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue Rhoi gwaed (p. 111); diffyg cwsg = lack of sleep (example at cwsg 0345)

karty.priklad: Mae gweld eirlysiau cynta'r flwyddyn yn rhoi gwên ar fy wyneb i.
karty.priklad_cs: Seeing the first snowdrops of the year puts a smile on my face (blwyddyn → [f]lwyddyn after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: eira (snow) + -lys (plant): the little snow-flower that pushes up through a blizzard.

extra.pozn: eirlysiau cynta'r flwyddyn is from p. 105, the sentence is adapted

karty.priklad: Y project nesa fydd troi hen gapel Bethania yn glwb ieuenctid.
karty.priklad_cs: The next project will be turning the old Bethania chapel into a youth club (capel → [g]apel after hen; clwb → [g]lwb after yn).
karty.mnemo: ifanc (young) → ieuenctid: youth club kids slurping blue slush puppies.

extra.pozn: no plural; sentence from the article on p. 115

karty.priklad: Eisteddon ni o flaen y lle tân drwy'r nos.
karty.priklad_cs: We sat in front of the fireplace all night.
karty.mnemo: lle (place) + tân (fire) = the place for the fire; masculine, so the flames burn icy blue.

extra.pozn: L9 gives the plural lle(oedd) tân, L11 llefydd tân, both correct; duplicate entry in L11; own example

karty.priklad: Dylwn i fod wedi gwisgo mwgwd.
karty.priklad_cs: I should have worn a mask.
karty.mnemo: mwg (smoke): a mask against smoke – a pale blue surgical mask.

extra.pozn: the link with mwg is only a memory aid; sentence from p. 105

karty.priklad: Mae rhybudd am wynt cryf heno.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a warning of strong wind tonight (gwynt → [w]ynt after am).
karty.mnemo: 'RE-BUILD (RHY-BUDD) the bridge before the ice breaks!' – a warning.

extra.pozn: rhybuddio = to warn (L12); own example

karty.priklad: Mae fy nhad mewn siâp da.
karty.priklad_cs: My dad is in good shape (tad → [nh]ad after fy).
karty.mnemo: From English SHAPE: in such good shape he glides about on ice skates.

extra.pozn: mewn siâp da = in good shape; own example
